# RingAnvil

> RingAnvil is an AI call-answering and lead-follow-up service for trades businesses (plumbing, HVAC, roofing, electrical). It is a brand of Apex Grid Engineering PLLC, based in Queen Creek, Arizona. Contact: info@ringanvil.com

Founder: Jeremy “Chico” Mills — Founder & CEO. Serial entrepreneur · USAF veteran. Jeremy Mills is the founder and owner of 10+ companies, led by Apex Grid Engineering. An Apex Grid Engineering PLLC company.

## What it does
- Answers inbound calls in the customer's business name, 24/7 or as overflow/after-hours cover
- Captures a structured lead (name, contact, service address, problem, urgency) and qualifies it against the business's service area and job-fit rules
- Holds appointment windows on the business's calendar rules for the team to confirm, or promises a callback window
- Follows up the business's own inbound leads by call/text with consent controls (STOP honoured by design; no cold outbound calling, ever)
- Hands every interaction back: summary, transcript/recording where lawful, booking, and an exception queue

## Rules it operates under
- Every call opens with a recorded-call disclosure
- The assistant identifies itself as automated when asked; it never claims to be a human employee
- Scripted emergencies route to the business's on-call number; danger to life is directed to 911 first
- It is a receptionist, not a technician: no diagnosis or pricing beyond the business's approved script and published rates

## Pilot pricing (test pricing)
- Overflow: $299/mo + $500 setup — 500 minutes included, $0.25/min overage
- Full Desk: $499/mo + $1,000 setup — 1,250 minutes included, $0.22/min overage
- Full Desk + Follow-Up: $799/mo + $1,000 setup — 2,000 minutes included, 500 text segments included, $0.22/min overage

## Frequently asked questions
- What does RingAnvil do? For pilot shops, RingAnvil answers calls in the business's name, captures a structured lead (name, contact, service address, problem, urgency), qualifies it against the business's service area and rules, and gathers a caller's preferred appointment window for the team to review. The pilot workflow is designed to prepare a structured call summary of every interaction. Automatic delivery to your team will be verified as part of pilot activation. Connected calendar holds and booking actions require separate configuration and verification.
- Are callers told the call is recorded and handled by an AI? Yes. Disclosure first, identity clear. RingAnvil is designed to identify its automated role and provide a recording disclosure at the start of a call. Recording and consent settings must be reviewed and configured for the business and applicable laws before live activation. If a caller asks, the assistant says plainly that it is an automated assistant and never claims to be a human employee.
- What happens on an emergency call? RingAnvil's pilot workflow is designed to identify urgent service requests and follow the business's approved escalation instructions. Live call transfers require configuration and verification before activation. For immediate danger or life-threatening emergencies, callers must contact 911. RingAnvil is not an emergency or dispatch service and never attempts to handle a life-safety emergency itself.
- Does RingAnvil make cold outbound calls? Never. Follow-up runs only as a configured pilot workflow: calls and texts go only to people who contacted your business first. Text follow-up honours STOP by design — instantly and permanently — and respects quiet hours in the recipient's timezone. No automated outbound follow-up is active today.
- How much does RingAnvil cost? Pilot pricing: Overflow $299 per month plus $500 setup (500 minutes included, $0.25 per minute overage); Full Desk $499 per month plus $1,000 setup (1,250 minutes included, $0.22 overage); Full Desk + Follow-Up $799 per month plus $1,000 setup (2,000 minutes and 500 text segments included, $0.22 overage).
